FrameTrail JSON Schemas

Version 1 of the FrameTrail data format
https://frametrail.org/schemas/1/

Overview

JSON Schemas (draft 2020-12) for the files in a FrameTrail _data folder, for the attributes of each item type and for the bundles that carry a hypervideo or a whole project as one document. These are the schemas of the latest FrameTrail release; each one's URL is its $id.

The schemas refer to each other by relative URLs, so a validator that is given all of them never fetches anything, and one that loads schemas by URL finds every reference here. The 1 is the version of the data format: additions that existing data does not need to change for keep it, a change to the meaning or shape of existing data gets a new number, and version 1 stays here.

docs/DATA-MODEL.md explains the files and how to validate them, also in an editor; docs/TYPES.md is the reference of the item types, made from the attribute schemas. The frametrail: terms in items are documented in the FrameTrail vocabulary. The source of these files is schemas/ in the FrameTrail repository.

Files of a _data folder

SchemaDescribes
config.schema.jsonInstance configuration: _data/config.json.
tagdefinitions.schema.jsonTag definitions: _data/tagdefinitions.json.
resources-index.schema.jsonThe resource library: _data/resources/_index.json.
hypervideos-index.schema.jsonThe hypervideo library: _data/hypervideos/_index.json.
hypervideo.schema.jsonA hypervideo: _data/hypervideos/<hypervideoId>/hypervideo.json.
content-item.schema.jsonOne item of a hypervideo's contents (hypervideo.json → contents): a W3C Web Annotation with FrameTrail extensions, either an overlay or a code snippet, told apart by frametrail:type.
annotations-index.schema.jsonThe index of a hypervideo's annotation files: _data/hypervideos/<hypervideoId>/annotations/_index.json.
annotation-file.schema.jsonA user's annotations of one hypervideo: _data/hypervideos/<hypervideoId>/annotations/<userId>.json, an array of W3C Web Annotations.

Bundles

SchemaDescribes
hypervideo-bundle.schema.jsonOne hypervideo with everything it needs, as one JSON document: the unit of export and import, independent of the _data folder layout.
project-bundle.schema.jsonA whole library as one JSON document: hypervideos with their annotations and subtitles, the overview map, the resources index, tag definitions and the playback settings.

Item types

The frametrail:attributes of an overlay, annotation or code snippet, and the attributes of a library resource, by type. Each type's schema is attributes/<type>.schema.json.

TypeWhat it is
audioAudio file with player controls: narration, music, a sound clip.
chartChart overlay: an animated bar, line or donut chart, or a progress ring, for numbers the video talks about.
codepenCodePen embed: a live HTML, CSS and JavaScript demo.
counterCounter overlay: a number that counts up or rolls like an odometer, for a figure or statistic the video mentions.
cursorCursor overlay: a mouse pointer with click ripples, for walking through a screen recording.
entityLinked data entity, such as a Wikidata item: a person, place or concept with its description.
figmaFigma embed: a design file or prototype.
hotspotHotspot overlay: a clickable shape (circle, rectangle, rounded rectangle) that marks something in the picture and can open a URL or jump to a time or another hypervideo, or a drawn mark (arrow, underline, freeform outline) that points something out.
htmlCustom HTML overlay or annotation, for what the other types cannot show.
imageImage: a picture, diagram or photo.
locationMap (OpenStreetMap via Leaflet) centred on a coordinate, for a place the video shows or mentions.
loomLoom video.
mastodonMastodon post.
pdfPDF document in a viewer: a handout, a paper, slides.
quizQuiz overlay or annotation: a question with answers to choose, or asking for a free text or a rating, at a point in the video.
soundcloudSoundCloud track or playlist.
spotifySpotify track, album, playlist or podcast.
textText overlay or annotation: rich text with an optional title and card style, for titles, captions, notes and explanations.
twitchTwitch video or live channel.
urlpreviewLink preview card: title, description and image of a page, or the platform's own embed for posts from Bluesky, X, TikTok, SlideShare, Reddit and Flickr.
videoVideo file (MP4, WebM or HLS) shown over or beside the hypervideo's own video.
vimeoVimeo video.
webpageWeb page shown in an iframe, or as a card when the site forbids embedding.
wikipediaWikipedia article summary, for background on a term, a person or an event.
wistiaWistia video.
youtubeYouTube video.
buttonLegacy. Bodies of type "button" exist in older data.

SchemaDescribes
common.schema.jsonDefinitions shared by the FrameTrail data schemas.
